game.rules:
**Battle for Bikini Bottom General Rules**

**Starting State**

Utilization of pre-run preparations (boot physics/phasing, combo storage, hans disabled state, save glitch) is prohibited until after the timer has started unless otherwise specified. Other save files cannot be prepared for use within the run before the timer starts.

Action replay codes are banned. In-game codes are banned unless otherwise specified.

**Video and Audio**

Acceptable video proof with game audio is required for all submissions with times under the **Video and Audio Proof Threshold**. Acceptable capture card footage is required for all submissions under the **Capture Card Threshold.** Emulation is banned beyond this point as well. Some categories may require acceptable video, audio and capture card proof for all submissions.

All video submissions must be published to a site that embeds to speedrun.com (e.g. YouTube, Twitch)

Twitch vod submissions must be highlighted. Past broadcasts are unacceptable video proof unless submitted on behalf of a moderator.

**Hardware and Emulation**

Dolphin is the only legal emulator. Dolphin submissions must accurately emulate the GameCube version (frame rate, loading times, original textures and mechanics) to be verified. Dolphin users are prohibited from utilizing lag abuse strategies.

All non-emulated submissions must be played on an official BfBB disc or original Xbox HDD. HDD loading on consoles other than the original Xbox is prohibited. Loading times must not be faster than possible on an OEM setup for both disc and HDD users. HDD users may force 480p.

Console hardware manipulation (PS2 disc eject) is banned.

Game file modifications of any kind are strictly prohibited.

**Gamepad Modifications, Adapters and Overlays**

Macro modifications for controllers are banned. Aesthetic controller mods, carving the controller shell, removing functionality (ex: rumble), replacing OEM controller parts, and adapters allowing unofficial controllers without console modification are allowed. Mods that do not add functionality and only improve the longevity of the controller (i.e. hall effect sensors, snapback capacitors) are allowed.

If remapping a controller layout through use of an adapter or emulator, face buttons may only be mapped to other face buttons, triggers to triggers, and sticks to sticks. Double mapping (having more than one of the same input, for example: 2 A buttons) is banned. Additional buttons and paddles not present on the original console's controller (ex: Xbox One Elite controller's back paddles) are banned.

External devices for analog/digital inputs (other than the controller itself) are banned.

Overlays including precise markings and/or input viewers designed to provide the player with useful feedback otherwise unobtainable through the base game is defined as tool assistance, and therefore banned. Programs analyzing gameplay in realtime to provide similarly unobtainable feedback are also banned. Imprecise overlays for entertainment purposes, such as analog stick viewers with no markings, values, or programmed cues, are acceptable. If unsure, please consult moderators privately or use the game's forum.

**Verification**

Moderators may request additional proof for submissions such as hand cams, input displays, Livesplit files and full vod recordings before verifying or rejecting.

Runs performed by the same user on two different accounts will be merged together if the moderation team becomes aware. This also applies to runs which were anonymized.

newsList.title: 100 Under 1 Challenge Complete!
newsList.body:
The 100 Under 1 challenge was a success! Thanks to all the runners who achieved sub hour in Battle for Bikini Bottom.

Watch the original announcement here: https://youtu.be/yaLMRBp6UVw

We reached 102 under 1, amounting to $2,400 for combatting childhood cancer.

---

Any% speedrun learning resources: https://bfbb.site/Any%25

**100% Requirements and Restrictions**

**Objective:** Collect all unique golden spatulas (100) and unique source collectibles intended to obtain them.

Required unique objectives:

- Collect 100 golden spatulas (full game)
- Find 80 lost socks (full game)
- Procure 1 King Jellyfish jelly (Jellyfish Fields)
- Recover 11 steering wheels (Downtown Bikini Bottom)
- Save 5 children (Goo Lagoon)
- Return 6 stolen artwork (Rock Bottom)
- Activate 4 security system buttons (Mermalair)
- Destroy 8 consecutive sandmen (Sand Mountain)
- Find 6 lost campers (Kelp Forest)
- Collect 6 power crystals (Kelp Forest)
- Ready 4 cannons for fire (Flying Dutchman's Graveyard)

All strategies used to duplicate, bypass or undermine collection and transaction to obtain 100 unique spatulas are banned. Effectively, the player must finish with 100 golden spatulas, 0 socks, and all level-exclusive objectives noted on the above list having been completed and traded for as intended.

Banned strategies as of March 3, 2023 as per category definition:

- Spatula duplication
- Spatula scamming
- Sock duplication
- Collectible counter abuse (CCA)
- Art skip

---

**Video and Audio Proof Threshold:** 1:50:00

**Capture Card Threshold:** 1:30:00

---

**Timer Start:** On input selecting the autosave preference on the new game screen, initiating the first loading screen.

**Timer End:** On destruction of the final fuse inside of Robo-SpongeBob, initiating the final cutscene. If the final fuse destruction is not visible in the game feed, the black "cutscene bars" must be fully visible to indicate when the fuse was hit.

---

Please view **Game Rules** for starting state, video/audio and hardware rules which apply to all categories.

---

100% speedrun learning resources: https://bfbb.site/100%25

**Gameplay Requirements**

Collect all golden spatulas, socks and level-specific (if applicable) collectibles in the level.

levels.name: Bikini Bottom
levels.rules:
---

**All submissions require acceptable video and audio. Emulators are banned.**

---

**Timer Start:** For Bikini Bottom ILs, start a new game and use in-game codes to unlock the bubble bowl and cruise bubble. Leave the rest of the game untouched. Start the timer on confirmation for loading the "SpongeBob's Closet" task after doing this.

**Timer End:** On menu pause after collecting the final objective. All required objectives must be displayed as completed in the menu.

---

**Gameplay Restrictions**

Hans may be enabled/disabled before starting the run. This must be indicated with the **Hans Start** variable upon submission.

Runs may be started with the "save glitch" active.

Warping to and from levels other than Bikini Bottom once the timer has started is prohibited.

---

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
**Any% Requirements and Restrictions**

**Objective:** Finish the game by defeating Robo-SpongeBob.

---

**Video and Audio Proof Threshold:** 1:05:00

**Capture Card Threshold:** 55:00

---

**Timer Start:** On input selecting the autosave preference on the new game screen, initiating the first loading screen.

**Timer End:** On destruction of the final fuse inside of Robo-SpongeBob, initiating the final cutscene. If the final fuse destruction is not visible in the game feed, the black "cutscene bars" must be fully visible to indicate when the fuse was hit.

---

Please view **Game Rules** for starting state, video/audio and hardware rules which apply to all categories.

---

Any% speedrun learning resources: https://bfbb.site/Any%25

games.name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom
games.rules:
**Battle for Bikini Bottom General Rules**

**Starting State**

Utilization of pre-run preparations (boot physics/phasing, combo storage, hans disabled state, save glitch) is prohibited until after the timer has started unless otherwise specified. Other save files cannot be prepared for use within the run before the timer starts.

Action replay codes are banned. In-game codes are banned unless otherwise specified.

**Video and Audio**

Acceptable video proof with game audio is required for all submissions with times under the **Video and Audio Proof Threshold**. Acceptable capture card footage is required for all submissions under the **Capture Card Threshold.** Emulation is banned beyond this point as well. Some categories may require acceptable video, audio and capture card proof for all submissions.

All video submissions must be published to a site that embeds to speedrun.com (e.g. YouTube, Twitch)

Twitch vod submissions must be highlighted. Past broadcasts are unacceptable video proof unless submitted on behalf of a moderator.

**Hardware and Emulation**

Dolphin is the only legal emulator. Dolphin submissions must accurately emulate the GameCube version (frame rate, loading times, original textures and mechanics) to be verified. Dolphin users are prohibited from utilizing lag abuse strategies.

All non-emulated submissions must be played on an official BfBB disc or original Xbox HDD. HDD loading on consoles other than the original Xbox is prohibited. Loading times must not be faster than possible on an OEM setup for both disc and HDD users. HDD users may force 480p.

Console hardware manipulation (PS2 disc eject) is banned.

Game file modifications of any kind are strictly prohibited.

**Gamepad Modifications, Adapters and Overlays**

Macro modifications for controllers are banned. Aesthetic controller mods, carving the controller shell, removing functionality (ex: rumble), replacing OEM controller parts, and adapters allowing unofficial controllers without console modification are allowed. Mods that do not add functionality and only improve the longevity of the controller (i.e. hall effect sensors, snapback capacitors) are allowed.

If remapping a controller layout through use of an adapter or emulator, face buttons may only be mapped to other face buttons, triggers to triggers, and sticks to sticks. Double mapping (having more than one of the same input, for example: 2 A buttons) is banned. Additional buttons and paddles not present on the original console's controller (ex: Xbox One Elite controller's back paddles) are banned.

External devices for analog/digital inputs (other than the controller itself) are banned.

Overlays including precise markings and/or input viewers designed to provide the player with useful feedback otherwise unobtainable through the base game is defined as tool assistance, and therefore banned. Programs analyzing gameplay in realtime to provide similarly unobtainable feedback are also banned. Imprecise overlays for entertainment purposes, such as analog stick viewers with no markings, values, or programmed cues, are acceptable. If unsure, please consult moderators privately or use the game's forum.

**Verification**

Moderators may request additional proof for submissions such as hand cams, input displays, Livesplit files and full vod recordings before verifying or rejecting.

Runs performed by the same user on two different accounts will be merged together if the moderation team becomes aware. This also applies to runs which were anonymized.
